interpretation_rules: A bounded search returning nothing means UNKNOWN, never that a statement is false.
A Python check is not a Lean-kernel proof.
Search-free replay means the search libraries are not loaded; it is not an independently implemented verification.
Manufactured examples favour the grammar that generated them.
Successful elaboration is not an axiom audit.
Producer/checker separation has three different strengths here and they are not equivalent: an opposite computation, replaced search entry points, and a shared assembler disclosed by its own author.
Elaborating a Lean specimen does not change what the specimen says.
An empty invariant packet is a vacuously valid preservation certificate, not evidence that no invariant exists.
A cover establishes the congruence it encodes, not the integer equality that motivated the choice of states.
